run_program_brainphoque: run a BrainPhoque UTM program with specified memory size, maximum steps, and output length
sample_program_universal: sample a random program of given length using a numpy random generator
create_fast_sampler: create a FastSampler for uniform i.i.d. token sampling with batched generation
create_mc_sampler: create an MCSampler using a Markov chain model loaded from a counts file for BrainPhoque programs
shorten_program_brainphoque: shorten a BrainPhoque program by removing unnecessary brackets, self-cancelling instructions, and post-output code
